The longitude belongs to the SECOND derived exterior subgroup, so its actual cyclic-cover class is zero, not merely zero in ordinary homology. MV and pair exactness therefore give the two specified actual H1 isomorphisms.

Primitive Alexander annihilation gives actual fraction-field H1 vanishing for every stated constant field, including modp. The exterior H1-dual vanishing uses an explicit section of d1 from finite-atlas path frames and the invertible meridian differential, not a choice-dependent splitting of an infinite vector space.

The closed/exterior cap comparison passes through (M,V) and collared excision to (X,T), with matching local orientation generators. The cohomology class of an actual closed primitive restricts to the required exterior primitive, yielding equality of pairing evaluations. No filling-orientation reversal sign is inserted.

The exterior whole-cochain rule is independent of representative cocycle, primitive and cycle because differences are actual coboundaries or integral evaluations. Closed cyclic-image nonsingularity has the required coefficient alternative and does not assert integral Laurent rings are principal ideal domains.

Rational/prime linking-form comparison is confined to the primitive-denominator-annihilated subgroup. A whole integral cochain c with delta c=Delta-star a supplies all forward coefficient maps; no nonexistent global map Q(t)->Fp(t) or infinite product lifting is used. The finite remainder argument gives an explicit finite exceptional-prime set.

The actual infection adjunction is an EPIMORPHISM in the inclusion direction W(j+1)->Wj, killing precisely the companion longitude. Simultaneous finite forest attachment kills the finite normal closure of ALL level-j longitudes. Every level-j longitude lies in ordinary derived depth n-j+1. The deep-normal-subgroup lemma consequently preserves mixed quotients through that index and the exact successive factor at depth n-j, even with the final Fp ring. These are actual quotient maps, not characteristicness alone.

The already surviving meridian therefore identifies its ACTUAL boundary coefficient image with an infinite cyclic subgroup.

That isometry uses the selected TWO-component boundary-union kernel theorem; single-component isotropy alone is not substituted.
